description: Local task workspace guardrail. Review exact hooks before trust; see docs/task-workspace.md for coverage limits.

hooks.command: task_workspace_root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) || exit 2; if [ ! -x "$task_workspace_root/.venv/bin/python" ]; then printf '%s\n' 'TASK_WORKSPACE_SETUP_REQUIRED: Run Poetry setup for Python 3.14.8.' >&2; exit 2; fi; exec "$task_workspace_root/.venv/bin/python" "$task_workspace_root/adapters/openai/task_workspace_hook.py"
